name: BT.Finance Curve aave-pool strategies unbounded slippage
summary: BT.Finance's USDC and USDT Curve strategies entered and left the Curve aave pool with no slippage bound, and anyone could trigger vault deposit and earn. With flash-loaned funds the attacker unbalanced the pool, deposited so vault funds entered at the distorted rate, restored the pool and redeemed its shares, leaving the slippage on depositors.
notes: The controller's setStrategy writes route vault funds into each strategy (upgrade resets). For the USDT leg the controller's vaults(USDT) was set to the bUSDT vault nine blocks after its setStrategy; controller.withdraw and strategy.withdraw both need it, so that write is the USDT target's latest reset.

Victims are the two vaults, the controller and both strategies. Their net gauge-staked a3CRV outflow per transaction is valued at the pool's pre-exploit get_virtual_price (1.01567), since DefiLlama has no price; part of that value stayed in the pool as imbalance fees rather than reaching the attacker.
